criteria.reason: Flags possible illegal e-waste export and dumping risk, though not explicitly non-working units.
Cites real Basel/GDPR/FADP issues without invented figures; GDPR applicability is generic but not clearly false.
Provides draft and recycler fallback, but omits sorting, donating/selling working units, and data-wipe plan.
Tone is professional and cautious, not personally accusatory.

summary: Helpful conditional draft and risk notes, but misses the specified practical sorting/donation alternative.
